title: The pool scenario's out metric records 7-24 tokens per run, far below the output its cost implies
goal: The pool scenario's out metric agrees with the run's output: the newest pool record's all-kinds out of every kb arm is above 100 tokens per run, and its cost matches the list price of the counted tokens within 20%

run: import csv,sys; rows=[r for r in csv.DictReader(open('kb/_self/reports/benchmarks.csv',encoding='utf-8')) if r['scenario']=='pool' and r['case']=='all' and r['metric']=='out' and r['arm'] in ('haiku-5-5:default','sonnet-5-5:low','haiku-4-5')]; sys.exit(1 if any(float(r['value'])<100 for r in rows) else 0)

repro_reason: The metric is wrong in the recorded rows of the 2026-10-08 pool record; a rerun needs paid model runs, so the repro reads the record's rows.
